ec2_proxy_s3_exfiltration.zip.title: AWS Cloud Bank Breach S3
ec2_proxy_s3_exfiltration.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries abusing a misconfigured EC2 reverse proxy to obtain instance profile keys and eventually exfiltrate files from an S3 bucket.

sh_arp_cache.zip.title: Arp Cache Discovery
sh_arp_cache.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor using arp to list out the arp cache.

sh_binary_padding_dd.zip.title: DD Binary Padding Hash Change
sh_binary_padding_dd.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor using dd to add a zero to the binary to change the hash.

empire_powerview_ldap_ntsecuritydescript.title: Empire Powerview Add-DomainObjectAcl
empire_powerview_ldap_ntsecuritydescript.description: This datasets represent adversaries with enough permissions (i.e. domain admin) adding an access control entry (ACE) to the discretionary access control list (DACL) of an Active Directory object (i.e Root Domain). One example could be adversaries modifying the root domain DACL to allow a specific domain user, despite being in no privileged groups and not having local admin rights on the domain controller itself, to use Active Directory replication services and obtain secret domain data (i.e. Other user NTLM Hashes)

empire_dcsync_dcerpc_drsuapi_dsgetncchan.title: Empire DCSync
empire_dcsync_dcerpc_drsuapi_dsgetncchan.description: This dataset represents adversaries abusing Active Directory Replication services to retrieve secret domain data (i.e. NTLM hashes) from domain accounts.

empire_shell_net_localgroup_administrato.title: Empire Net Local Administrators Group
empire_shell_net_localgroup_administrato.description: This dataset represents adversaries enumerating members of the local Administratrors group via the net.exe utility

empire_shell_net_local_users.zip.title: Empire Net Local Users
empire_shell_net_local_users.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries enumerating all local users on an endpoint

empire_shell_samr_enumdomainusers.zip.title: Empire Net Domain Users
empire_shell_samr_enumdomainusers.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries enumerating all users that belong to a domain via RPC SAMR EnumDomainUsers.

empire_persistence_registry_modification.title: Empire Userland Registry Run Keys
empire_persistence_registry_modification.description: This dataset represents adversaries modifying local Run registry keys (i.e. HKLM:SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run) for persistence. It also captures the execution of the persistence mechanism.

empire_schtasks_creation_standard_user.z.title: Empire Userland Scheduled Tasks
empire_schtasks_creation_standard_user.z.description: This dataset represents adversaries creating and/or executing local scheduled tasks to maintain persistence in an environment.

empire_over_pth_patch_lsass.zip.title: Empire Over-Pass-The-Hash
empire_over_pth_patch_lsass.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries taking a hash/key (rc4_hmac, aes256_cts_hmac_sha1, etc.) for a domain-joined user into a fully-fledged Kerberos TGT. In this case, an adversary can write the hash/key into an existing logon session (i.e. a sacrificial logon session) section in the memory content of LSASS and kick off the regular Kerberos authentication process.

empire_shell_rubeus_asktgt_ptt.zip.title: Rubeus Userland ASKTGT PTT
empire_shell_rubeus_asktgt_ptt.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries crafting raw AS-REQ (TGT request) traffic for a specific user and encryption key (/rc4, /aes128, /aes256, or /des) to request TGTs without touching lsass.

empire_shell_dcerpc_smb_service_dll_hija.title: IKEEXT Remote Service DLL Hijack
empire_shell_dcerpc_smb_service_dll_hija.description: This dataset represents adversaries copying a file remotely to replace a file which is executed by a service that is vulnerable to DLL hijack. This dataset includes

empire_launcher_vbs.zip.title: Empire VBS Execution
empire_launcher_vbs.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries executing a VBS script as a launcher for initial access.

empire_wmi_local_event_subscriptions_ele.title: Empire Elevated WMI Eventing
empire_wmi_local_event_subscriptions_ele.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging WMI subscriptions locally for persistence.

empire_psinject_peinjection.zip.title: Empire PSInject
empire_psinject_peinjection.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries reflectively loading/intecting a portable executable (PE) (not on disk) into a process via WriteprocessMemory and executed via CreateRemoteThread APIs

empire_shell_rpc_samr_smb_group_domain_a.title: Empire Shell Net Domain Admins
empire_shell_rpc_samr_smb_group_domain_a.description: This dataset represents adversaries enumerating members of domain groups (i.e. Domain Admins) via RPC SAMR interface over SMB. Some of the main RPC methods captured over the network are SamrLookupNamesInDomain (Opnum 17) and SamrQueryInformationGroup (Opnum 20) where there are indicators about the specific group name enumerated.

empire_wdigest_downgrade.tar.gz.title: Empire WDigest Downgrade
empire_wdigest_downgrade.tar.gz.description: This dataset represents adversaries setting the UseLogonCredential property value from HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest key to 1 to enable plain text passwords.

empire_mimikatz_logonpasswords.zip.title: Empire Mimikatz LogonPasswords
empire_mimikatz_logonpasswords.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries reading credentials from the memory contents of lsass.exe. One popular tool performing this behavior is Mimikatz.

empire_enable_rdp.tar.gz.title: Empire Enable RDP
empire_enable_rdp.tar.gz.description: This dataset represents adversaries enabling RDP and adding a firewall exception to a compromised system

empire_smbexec_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.zip.title: Empire Invoke SMBExec
empire_smbexec_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries remotely creating and starting a service via RPC methods over SMB named pipes such as svcctl.

empire_psexec_dcerpc_tcp_svcctl.zip.title: Empire Invoke PsExec
empire_psexec_dcerpc_tcp_svcctl.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries remotely creating and starting a service via RPC methods over TCP.

empire_dcom_shellwindows_stager.zip.title: Empire Invoke DCOM ShellWindows
empire_dcom_shellwindows_stager.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries executing commands remotely via DCOM ShellWindows COM Method.

empire_psremoting_stager.zip.title: Empire Invoke PSRemoting
empire_psremoting_stager.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries executing malicious code on remote hosts using PowerShell Remoting (WinRM).

empire_msbuild_dcerpc_wmi_smb.zip.title: Empire Invoke Execute MSBuild
empire_msbuild_dcerpc_wmi_smb.zip.description: This dataset represents an adversary remotely creating a file (.xml) via SMB and executing it remotetly via WMI and msbuild. This dataset focuses on the use of the WMI Win32_Process class and method Create to execute code remotely.

empire_dllinjection_loadlibrary_createre.title: Empire Invoke DLLInjection
empire_dllinjection_loadlibrary_createre.description: This dataset represents a threat actor injecting a Dll (On Disk) into an arbitrary process via LoadLibrary and executd by CreateRemoteThread APIs

empire_find_localadmin_smb_svcctl_opensc.title: Empire Find Local Admin Access
empire_find_localadmin_smb_svcctl_opensc.description: This dataset represents adversaries using the OpenSCManagerW Win32API call to establish a handle to the remote host and verify if the current user context has local administrator acess to the target.

empire_mimikatz_extract_keys.zip.title: Empire Mimikatz Extract Kerberos Keys
empire_mimikatz_extract_keys.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries extracting kerberos tickets from memory.

empire_mimikatz_backupkeys_dcerpc_smb_ls.title: Empire Mimikatz Backup Keys
empire_mimikatz_backupkeys_dcerpc_smb_ls.description: This dataset represents adversaries retrieving the DPAPI Domain Backup Key from the DC via RPC LSARPC methods over SMB.

empire_getsession_dcerpc_smb_srvsvc_nets.title: Empire Remote Get Session
empire_getsession_dcerpc_smb_srvsvc_nets.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging RPC SRVSVC and the method NetSessEnum over SMB to query remote hosts for active sessions

empire_mimikatz_sam_access.zip.title: Empire Mimikatz SAM Extract Hashes
empire_mimikatz_sam_access.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries calculating the SysKey to decrypt Security Account Mannager (SAM) database entries (from registry or hive) and get NTLM, and sometimes LM hashes of local accounts password.

empire_shell_reg_dump_sam.zip.title: Empire Reg Dump SAM Hive
empire_shell_reg_dump_sam.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries with administrator privileges using the windows reg utility to dump the SAM registry hive.

rdp_interactive_taskmanager_lsass_dump.z.title: RDP TaskManager LSASS Dump
rdp_interactive_taskmanager_lsass_dump.z.description: This dataset represents adversaries using RDP and task manager interactively and dump the memory space of lsass.

covenant_installutil.zip.title: Covenant ShellCmd InstallUtil
covenant_installutil.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries proxy executing code through InstallUtil, a trusted Windows utility.

empire_monologue_netntlm_downgrade.zip.title: Empire Invoke InternalMonologue
empire_monologue_netntlm_downgrade.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries downgrading the challenge/response authentication protocol used for network logons, the minimum security negotiated for applications using NTLMSSP, and security settings that restrict outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers in an environment

msf_record_mic.zip.title: MSF Record Mic
msf_record_mic.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries accessing the microphone of an endpoint.

empire_launcher_sct_regsvr32.zip.title: Empire Regsvr32 Execution
empire_launcher_sct_regsvr32.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging regsvr32 to proxy the execution of an empire payload (.sct file) to create a reverse connection to the C2.

empire_persistence_registry_modification.title: Empire Elevated Registry Run Keys
empire_persistence_registry_modification.description: This dataset represents adversaries modifying local Run registry keys (i.e. HKLM:SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run) for persistence. It also captures the execution of the persistence mechanism.

covenant_wmi_remote_event_subscription_a.title: Covenant Remote WMI Eventing ActiveScriptEventConsumers
covenant_wmi_remote_event_subscription_a.description: This dataset represents adversaries using WMI event subscriptions (ActiveScriptEventConsumers) remotely to move laterally.

covenant_dcsync_dcerpc_drsuapi_dsgetncch.title: Covenant DCSync
covenant_dcsync_dcerpc_drsuapi_dsgetncch.description: This dataset represents adversaries abusing Active Directory Replication services to retrieve secret domain data (i.e. NTLM hashes) from domain accounts.

covenant_sc_query_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.zip.title: Covenant SC.exe Utility Query
covenant_sc_query_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.zip.description: This dataset represents an adversary leveraging the sc.exe utility to query (RPC QueryServiceStatus method) for the statu of a service on a remote endpoint.

covenant_sharpsc_query_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.title: Covenant SharpSC Query
covenant_sharpsc_query_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.description: This dataset represents a threat actor leveraging the RPC method EnumServiceStatusW over SMB svcctl to query the status of a service on a remote endpoint..

covenant_copy_smb_createrequest.zip.title: Covenant Remote File Copy
covenant_copy_smb_createrequest.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor remotely copying a file over SMB (CreateRequest).

covenant_sharpsc_create_dcerpc_smb_svcct.title: Covenant SharpSC Create
covenant_sharpsc_create_dcerpc_smb_svcct.description: This dataset represents adversaries remotely creating a service via RPC methods such as CreateService over SMB named pipes such as svcctl.

covenant_sharpsc_start_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.title: Covenant SharpSC Start
covenant_sharpsc_start_dcerpc_smb_svcctl.description: This dataset represents adversaries remotely starting a service via RPC methods such as StartService over SMB named pipes such as svcctl.

covenant_sharpsc_stop_dcerpc_smb_svcctl..title: Covenant SharpSC Stop Service
covenant_sharpsc_stop_dcerpc_smb_svcctl..description: This dataset represents a threat actor using the RPC ControlService method over SMB to stop a service.

covenant_sharpwmi_create_dcerpc_wmi.zip.title: Covenant SharpWMI Exec
covenant_sharpwmi_create_dcerpc_wmi.zip.description: This dataset represents an adversary remotely executing code via WMI. This dataset focuses on the use of the WMI Win32_Process class and method Create to execute code remotely.

covenant_psremoting_command.zip.title: Covenant PowerShell Remoting Command
covenant_psremoting_command.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries executing malicious code on remote hosts using PowerShell Remoting (WinRM).

covenant_getdomaingroup_ldap_searchreque.title: Covenant GetDomainGroup Domain Admins
covenant_getdomaingroup_ldap_searchreque.description: This dataset represents a threat actor enumerating the domain groups via LDAP (i.e. SearchRequest Method) in an environment.

empire_mimikatz_lsadump_patch.zip.title: Empire Mimikatz Lsadump LSA Patch
empire_mimikatz_lsadump_patch.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries reading credentials from the memory contents of lsass.exe. One popular tool performing this behavior is Mimikatz.

empire_uac_shellapi_fodhelper.zip.title: Invoke BypassUAC FodHelper
empire_uac_shellapi_fodhelper.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries elevating privileges (bypassing uac) by performing an registry modification for FodHelper.

empire_wmic_add_user_backdoor.zip.title: Empire Remote WMIC Add User
empire_wmic_add_user_backdoor.zip.description: This dataset represents an adversary remotely executing code via WMI to ad a backdoor user on the target system. This dataset focuses on the use of the WMI Win32_Process class and method Create to execute code remotely.

mimikatz_cve-2020-1472_unauthenticated_n.title: Mimikatz Netlogon Unauthenticated NetrServerAuthenticate2
mimikatz_cve-2020-1472_unauthenticated_n.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging a vulnerability (CVE-2020-1472) in a cryptographic authentication scheme used by the Netlogon Remote Protocol, which among other things can be used to update computer passwords. This vulnerability was discovered by [@@SecuraBV](https://twitter.com/SecuraBV).

covenant_dcom_executeexcel4macro_allowed.title: DCOM ExecuteExcel4macro
covenant_dcom_executeexcel4macro_allowed.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging the COM Method ExecuteExcel4Macro over DCOM to execute Excel4 macros remotely

covenant_dcom_registerxll.zip.title: DCOM RegisterXLL
covenant_dcom_registerxll.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging the COM Method RegisterXLL over DCOM to execute an XLL file remotely. The XLL file can exist on the target or externally in an UNC path such as \\SERVER\FILES\.

empire_wmi_dcerpc_wmi_iwbemservices_exec.title: Empire Invoke WMI
empire_wmi_dcerpc_wmi_iwbemservices_exec.description: This dataset represents an adversary remotely executing code via WMI. This dataset focuses on the use of the WMI Win32_Process class and method Create to execute code remotely.

empire_schtasks_creation_execution_eleva.title: Empire Elevated Scheduled Tasks
empire_schtasks_creation_execution_eleva.description: This dataset represents adversaries creating and/or executing local scheduled tasks to maintain persistence in an environment.

empire_shell_rubeus_asktgt_createnetonly.title: Rubeus Elevated ASKTGT CreateNetOnly
empire_shell_rubeus_asktgt_createnetonly.description: This dataset represents adversaries crafting raw AS-REQ (TGT request) traffic for a specific user and encryption key (/rc4, /aes128, /aes256, or /des) to request TGTs without touching lsass.

empire_powerdump_sam_access.zip.title: Empire Powerdump Extract Hashes
empire_powerdump_sam_access.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries calculating the SysKey to decrypt Security Account Mannager (SAM) database entries (from registry or hive) and get NTLM, and sometimes LM hashes of local accounts password.

covenant_wmi_wbemcomn_dll_hijack.zip.title: Covenant Remote WMI Wbemcomn DLL Hijacking
covenant_wmi_wbemcomn_dll_hijack.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries abusing a DLL hijack vulnerability found in the execution of the WMI provider host (wmiprvse.exe) for lateral movement.

covenant_dcom_iertutil_dll_hijack.zip.title: Covenant Remote DCOM Iertutil DLL Hijacking
covenant_dcom_iertutil_dll_hijack.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries abusing a DLL hijack vulnerability found in the execution of the DCOM InternetExplorer.Application class for lateral movement.

covenant_lolbin_wuauclt_createremotethre.title: Covenant Wuauclt CreateRemoteThread Execution
covenant_lolbin_wuauclt_createremotethre.description: This dataset represents adversaries proxy executing code via the Windows Update client utility. In order to bypass rules looking for the binary reaching out directly to the Internet, this dataset shows the binary creating and running a thread in the virtual address space of another process via the CreateRemoteThread API.

wmic_remote_xsl_jscript.zip.title: WMIC Remote XSL Jscript Execution
wmic_remote_xsl_jscript.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries proxy executing code and bypassing application controls by leveraging wmic and the `/FORMAT` argument switch to download and execute an XSL file (jscript).

psh_lsass_memory_dump_comsvcs.zip.title: Lsass Memory Dump via Comsvcs.dll
psh_lsass_memory_dump_comsvcs.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging the MiniDump export function from comsvcs.dll via rundll32 to perform a memory dump from lsass.

cmd_lsass_memory_dumpert_syscalls.zip.title: Lsass Memory Dump via Syscalls
cmd_lsass_memory_dumpert_syscalls.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries using system calls (syscalls) and API unhooking to dump the memoty contents of lsass.

cmd_sam_copy_esentutl.zip.title: SAM Copy via Esentutl VSS
cmd_sam_copy_esentutl.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries copying the SAM hive using the esentutl.exe utility and volume shadow copy services.

cmd_psexec_lsa_secrets_dump.zip.title: Psexec Reg LSA Secrets Dump
cmd_psexec_lsa_secrets_dump.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries using psexec to run reg.exe as system and dump LSA secrets. Location HKLM\security\policy\secrets.

cmd_userinitmprlogonscript_batch.zip.title: Logon Scripts via UserInitMprLogonScript
cmd_userinitmprlogonscript_batch.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging logon initialization scripts to achieve persistence via the UserInitMprLogonScript user environment.

psh_input_capture_promptforcreds.zip.title: UI Prompt For Credentials Function
psh_input_capture_promptforcreds.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries leveraging functions such as CredUIPromptForCredentials to create and display a configurable dialog box that accepts credentials information from a user.

cmd_netsh_fw_mod_open_ports.zip.title: Netsh Open FW Proxy Ports
cmd_netsh_fw_mod_open_ports.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries modifying the local FW by opening port for proxy.

cmd_service_mod_fax.zip.title: Service Modification Fax
cmd_service_mod_fax.zip.description: This dataset represents adversaries modifying a local service to execute powershell.

cmd_discover_iexplorer_version_registry..title: Internet Explorer Version Discovery
cmd_discover_iexplorer_version_registry..description: This dataset represents threat actors querying HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Microsoft\Internet Explorer to get the version of internet explorer installed on the system.

psh_hh_local_html_payload.zip.title: HH Execution of Local Compiled HTML Payload
psh_hh_local_html_payload.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors executing local compiled HTML Help payloads via hh.exe.

psh_control_panel_execution.zip.title: Control Panel Execution
psh_control_panel_execution.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging control.exe to execute a .cpl file to proxy execute another payload (i.e. calc).

psh_cmstp_execution_bypassuac.zip.title: CMSTP Proxy Execution
psh_cmstp_execution_bypassuac.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging CMSTP to execute an Inf file to proxy execute other malicious commands (i.e. cmd.exe). (Embedding commands in the RunPreSetupCommandsSection of the INF file).

cmd_mshta_javascript_getobject_sct.zip.title: Mshta Javascript GetObject Sct
cmd_mshta_javascript_getobject_sct.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging mshta.exe to proxy execute malicious .sct files via Javascript.

cmd_mshta_vbscript_execute_psh.zip.title: Mshta VBScript Execute PowerShell
cmd_mshta_vbscript_execute_psh.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging mshta.exe to proxy execute malicious powershell commands via vbscript.

psh_mshta_html_application_execution.zip.title: Mshta HTML Application (HTA) Execution
psh_mshta_html_application_execution.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging mshta.exe to proxy execute malicious commands via an .hta file.

purplesharp_ad_playbook_i.zip.title: PurpleSharp Active Directory Playbook I
purplesharp_ad_playbook_i.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors performing a few techniques in Active Directory to brute force passwords, request Kerberos ticket-granting service (TGS) service tickets from all SPNs, test access to remote network shares, and move laterally over Windows Remote Management (WinRM).

psh_register_cimprovider_execute_dll.zip.title: Register-CimProvider Execute Dll
psh_register_cimprovider_execute_dll.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging Register-Cimprovider to execute a malicious Dll.

cmd_bitsadmin_download_psh_script.zip.title: Bitsadmin Download Malicious File
cmd_bitsadmin_download_psh_script.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors leveraging bitsadmin.exe to download a file.

purplesharp_pe_injection_createremotethr.title: PurpleSharp PE Injection CreateRemoteThread
purplesharp_pe_injection_createremotethr.description: This dataset represents threat actors injecting portable executables (PE) into processes via APIs such asVirtualAllocEx and WriteProcessMemory and running it on the virtual address space of another process via the CreateRemoteThread API.

cmd_process_herpaderping_snippingtool.zi.title: Process Herpaderping Mimikatz
cmd_process_herpaderping_snippingtool.zi.description: This dataset represents the execution of a Process Herpaderping to obscure the intentions of a process by modifying the content on disk after the image has been mapped.

psh_windows_vault_web_credentials.zip.title: Windows Vault Web Credentials
psh_windows_vault_web_credentials.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors accessing the Windows Vault and reading web credentials saved.

psh_python_webserver.zip.title: Python HTTP Server
psh_python_webserver.zip.description: This dataset represents threat actors adding a FW inbound rule and starting a Python HTTP Server.

cmd_sharpview_pcre_net.zip.title: SharpView PCRE.NET
cmd_sharpview_pcre_net.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor leveraging SharpView and specific functions such as Get-ObjectAcl creating files and loading dlls related to PCRE.NET use.

psh_powershell_httplistener.zip.title: PowerShell HTTP Listener
psh_powershell_httplistener.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor using PowerShell to start an HTTP Listener on a compromised endpoint

cmd_seatbelt_group_user.zip.title: Seatbelt Group User Discovery
cmd_seatbelt_group_user.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor using Seatbelt profiling an endpoint. This specifically uses the -group=user command.

schtask_create.zip.title: Remote Scheduled Task Creation
schtask_create.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor creating a scheduled task remotely using schtasks.

schtask_modification.zip.title: Remote Scheduled Task Modification
schtask_modification.zip.description: This dataset represents a threat actor modifying a scheduled task remotely.

proxylogon_ssrf_rce_poc.zip.title: Exchange ProxyLogon SSRF RCE Vuln POC
proxylogon_ssrf_rce_poc.zip.description: This dataset represents the execution of a public POC to abuse Exchange vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-26855 server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability)
